direction: Sharpen the ruin-selection priority hook for the documented weakest regimes (tight capacity, uniform demand, size 100, eccentric depot, clustered spatial): replace the current removal-savings-only ranking with a scale-invariant multiplicative blend of (a) per-node removal savings normalized by mean savings, (b) load-relief pressure (removed demand / route load, which matters most at tight capacity), and (c) Shaw-style geographic relatedness to the seed node's route centroid (clustered spatial), then anneal that blend toward a milder, stagnation-driven schedule as iter_frac grows so late LNS iterations explore rather than re-destroy the same high-savings nodes.

operations.mechanism: KB method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 confirms the L3 template's only evolvable degree of freedom is score_ruin_nodes, with deterministic Regret-2 repair and Record-to-Record acceptance fixed, and that even the strongly-performing control (Worst-Cost Removal) leaves measurable headroom; method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret and method-cvrp-cheapest-regret-insertion establish that destroy-operator choice (worst/related/random mix) is where LNS gains concentrate when repair is held fixed. Archive feedback shows the whole portfolio is compressed into a 0.43% band around SBS 15.7435 with complementary winners (r0001 wins 10 instances, r0004 wins 5), i.e. remaining signal is per-regime rather than global, and the weakest regimes are tight capacity, clustered spatiality, uniform demand and size 100 — exactly the regime where load-relief and relatedness terms should dominate raw savings. The annealed savings decay targets the known failure mode of re-destroying identical high-savings nodes under stagnation, keeping the anytime curve productive across the full 500 ms.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms, a ruin priority that multiplies normalized removal savings by tight-capacity load relief (demand/route_load) and by within-route geographic compactness, with a stagnation_ratio- and iter_frac-driven decay of the savings term, will lower mean objective below the current SBS 15.7435 — because the portfolio's residual VBS gap (0.43%) and all five weakest regimes sit on tight-capacity, clustered, size-100 instances where pure savings ranking repeatedly removes the same long-detour nodes and leaves infeasible-ish, load-imbalanced routes for Regret-2 to repair.
